name: comp-166
title: Pricing Plan Radio Picker
description: A vertical radio list of four subscription plans with their prices, joined into one bordered column. The selected plan takes a lighter background, and the Plus row carries a Popular badge.
use: At signup or upgrade, when one of a few priced tiers must be chosen in a narrow space.
avoid: Rows show only a name and price, so a plan needing a feature list is a poor fit for this shape.
a11y: Real radios with visible labels, and each price is linked to its radio by aria-describedby; arrow keys move the choice and nothing animates. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four rows stack flush inside a single thin grey outline on black, each row holding a radio circle, a plan name on the left and a small grey price on the right. Plus shows a white Popular pill beside its name, and its row has a lighter grey fill.
behaves: Clicking a row fills its radio dot and raises the row's background and border. The recording starts with Plus chosen and switches to Hobby, then back to Plus.
customise: Plans come from an items array in the file; edit names, prices, values and which row takes the badge there. Row padding, radius and the accent fill are classes in the same file.
weight: light: Four static rows with native radios; the state swap has no animation.
